mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_trade_receipt_inbox (event_id,event_type,source_tenant_id,source_order_id,evidence_version,receipt_reference, change_reason,currency,paid_minor,refund_minor,cumulative_refunded_minor,pending_refund_minor, occurred_at,payload_digest,kafka_topic,kafka_partition,kafka_offset) VALUES (#{eventId},#{eventType},#{sourceTenantId},#{sourceOrderId},#{evidenceVersion},#{receiptReference}, #{changeReason},#{currency},#{paidMinor},#{refundMinor},#{cumulativeRefundedMinor},#{pendingRefundMinor}, #{occurredAt},#{payloadDigest},#{topic},#{partition},#{offset}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id=event_id
mapper.select: SELECT payload_digest FROM mk_trade_receipt_inbox WHERE event_id=#{eventId} FOR UPDATE
